Next send three parallel rays from the emitter vertically onto the lens.
After refraction, they meet at one point behind the lens, as in Figure 170.
Three is the number of rays used in this experimental step; the thin-lens and paraxial conditions still apply.

**In the paraxial model, rays parallel to the principal axis meet at one point after refraction by a converging lens; that point is a principal focus**.
The focus is denoted by $F$, as in Figure 171a.
